question: Sale prices at the Ajax Outlet Store are \(50\%\) below original prices. On Saturdays an additional discount of \(20\%\) off the sale price is given. What is the Saturday price of a coat whose original price is \(\$180?\)
solution:
The Saturday discount applies to the sale price, so calculate that price first. A \(50\%\) reduction leaves \(50\%\) of the original price:
\[
180\times0.50=90.
\]
The additional \(20\%\) reduction leaves \(80\%\) of this \(\$90\) sale price:
\[
90\times0.80=72.
\]
The Saturday price is \(\$72\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
